utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll send Jules a short blurb that mentions the loose steps and broken fence panel for Saturday afternoon. Oren is still double-checking the 9 to 2 time at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you also check whether we’ve got a car with trunk space by Friday afternoon? We still need the tool boxes and paint cans picked up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check that by Friday afternoon and let you know if we have a car with trunk space for the tool boxes and paint cans.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — the repair drive’s at the community center Saturday from 9 to 2, and folks should come in through the side entrance by the loading bay.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll keep nudging folks to come help sort donations and carry boxes. Thanks for dropping those spare tools by the shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m glad the spare tools will help, and I’ll keep spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m just waiting on the last couple of confirmations, then I’ll send out the final repair drive details. We’ve already got help lined up from Dane, Jules, Rey, and Bo.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, but the exact time and drop-off details aren’t set yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, that’s right — it’s still on, and I’ll send the final time and drop-off details as soon as the last confirmations come in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — if you’ve got any small items that need fixing, bring them along to the repair drive. I’m also waiting on a couple confirmations before the final details go out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep it around the school schedule and pass along the final time once Oren confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Faye — once Oren confirms, I’ll pass the final time along to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Faye to send the repair drive location and timing, so I can’t lock in the details yet. Once she does, I’ll confirm the drop-off and pickup info.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supply bin and make a fresh list for Sunday at the community center. Once the details come in, I can help keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’m still waiting on Faye’s location and timing, and once I have them I’ll lock in the drop-off and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s mainly the loose steps and that broken fence panel. I’ve got my drill ready for Saturday afternoon once Oren pins down the time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll spread the word right away and ask a few neighbors to join in on Saturday afternoon. I’ll tell them to bring any tools or spare supplies they can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—I might miss a detail, but that covers it. I’ll bring my drill on Saturday afternoon once Oren confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Leo — the repair drive stays set for Saturday from 9 to 2 at the community center, and folks can drop things off at the side entrance by the loading bay. If anything changes, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll send Bo the item list once it’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — that’ll help keep things organized. I’ll keep the plan steady and let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center from 9 to 2, and you can drop things off at the side entrance near the loading bay. I’ll pass along any volunteer updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the final location and timing before I lock anything in. Also, do you know the pickup address for the boxes and paint cans yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not yet — I only know the community center drop-off at the side entrance near the loading bay. I’ll keep an eye out and pass along the pickup address as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m bringing my pickup, a flashlight, and some basic tools. I’ll help check off the houses we’ve already covered too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. We’re set on tools for now — mostly we still need a few extra hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can do the sorting and box-carrying, and I’ll still bring the truck and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — could you sort the donations and carry boxes on Saturday morning at the usual community center lot?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations and help with the boxes on Saturday morning. I’ll be there at the community center from 9 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rey — 9 to 2 at the community center lot works. I’ll handle the rest, and I’ll make sure Ira gets the exact drop-off spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m running errands, but I’ll swing by the repair drive soon to help out. I’ve got the community center side entrance by the loading bay and the 9 to 2 window in mind.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yep, that’s the right spot and time. Rosa’s keeping folks updated, and Gus still has a couple tools he can lend if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll head over soon and I can use those tools if they’re still handy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping the sign-up list and repair summary moving, and Rey, Cleo, and I are getting the boxes and supplies in order.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ve got a couple more tools I can lend, and I can send Mina the pickup address too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Gus — thank you. Please send Mina the community center address, and I’ll add your tools to the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good — once Oren confirms the final time, I’ll keep the sign-up list and repair summary moving. Then you can share the Sunday community center details with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the Saturday community center details now so everyone has the location and timing. Once Oren confirms the final time, we can lock the list in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — just make sure it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list and summary moving until Oren confirms the final time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got my pickup, a flashlight, and some basic tools ready. I’ll help check off the houses as we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, Bo — that’ll help a lot. We still need a few more hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can lend a hand with that too — I’ll help sort donations and carry boxes at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday at the community center, 9 to 2, right? I can help sort donations if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that’s right — Saturday from 9 to 2 at the community center, side entrance by the loading bay. And yes please, if you can help sort donations, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll be there Saturday and help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still have a couple more tools I can lend for the repair drive, and I’m sorting donations and hauling boxes today. We’re also still looking for a trunk-space car by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. Your tools and help are a real relief — we still need a few more hands for sorting and boxes, and I’ll let you know about the car by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help — I can keep sorting and carrying boxes, and if Mina finds a trunk-space car by Friday afternoon, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on Faye for the location and timing before I can lock anything in. Once we have the drop-off and pickup address, I can figure out whether we’ve got a car with enough trunk space by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The plan’s steady: Saturday at the community center, 9 to 2, with drop-off at the side entrance by the loading bay. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’ll still need the pickup address before I can confirm the car and trunk space for Friday afternoon. If anything shifts, please let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send Bo the item list as soon as it’s sorted. The repair drive is at the community center from 9 to 2, with drop-off by the side entrance near the loading bay.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the final location and timing before I organize the rest. Once that’s in, I’ll confirm the drop-off and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—once Faye confirms, I’ll pass along Bo’s pickup help and the item list. Tess and Quinn are already keeping an eye out for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, and I can spread the word too. I can also bring over a couple tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Nell — please do spread the word, and bring those tools if you can. I’ll let a few neighbors know right away too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will — I heard it’s at the community center from 9 to 2, with drop-off by the side entrance near the loading bay. I’ll tell folks and bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supply bin and make a fresh list for Sunday. If you hear of any extra tools or supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands now, but I’ll swing by the repair drive soon and send along anything extra I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll keep updating the list and make sure we’re ready for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need a car with trunk space by Friday afternoon, plus someone to pick up the donated tools and paint cans. Do you have the pickup address handy for Pia?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’ve got it handy, and I’ll send Pia the pickup address right away along with the trunk-space request.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’m just checking that we still have a car lined up with enough trunk space by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bo’s keeping track of which houses have been checked, and the drop-off is still the usual community center lot on Saturday morning. I’ll make sure Hana knows Ira still needs the exact spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for Oren’s time check before sharing anything, since I have Saturday afternoon at 9 to 2 at the community center noted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works — I’ll wait for Oren’s time check too, and then I can pass along the confirmed Saturday morning details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ve got my drill for Saturday afternoon. Once Oren confirms the time, Faye can pass it along to Opal too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — it’s at the community center from 9 to 2, and drop-off is by the side entrance near the loading bay. Oren said he’ll let everyone know right away once he locks the time down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — at the community center, got it. I’ll keep my drill ready and wait for Oren’s final time.
